description: A legacy index after an attribute-only splat's attribute access is part of its each expression
notes: The spec's grammar lets an attribute-only splat consume only attribute accesses (attrSplat = "." "*" GetAttr*) and says a legacy index is an index operation, not an attribute access, so .0 would apply to the splat's result. hashicorp/hcl deliberately includes legacy indexes in an attribute-only splat (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go).
